import json,random,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/fz')
src=open('/app/submission/main.py').read().replace("\nmain()\n","")
g={}; exec(compile(src,"m","exec"),g)
import validate
from brute import analyse
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); trials=int(sys.argv[2])
maxn=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 9
random.seed(seed)
bad=0
for trial in range(trials):
    P=random.choice([1,2,3,4]); R=random.choice([1,2,2,3]); D=random.choice([0,1,1,2])
    inp=[[[random.randint(-3,3) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for _ in range(P)]
    n=random.randint(1,maxn)
    states=[]
    for i in range(n):
        dl=[]
        for r in range(P):
            k=random.randint(0,R)
            dl.append([[random.randint(-5,5) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(k)])
        if random.random()<0.4:
            dl=[]
            for r in range(P):
                k=random.randint(0,R)
                dl.append([[sum(inp[x][q][j] for x in range(P)) for j in range(D)] for q in range(k)])
        sl=[]; used=set()
        for _ in range(random.randint(0,2)):
            if R==0: break
            rq=random.randrange(R)
            if rq in used: continue
            used.add(rq)
            ranks=sorted(random.sample(range(P), random.randint(0,P)))
            ssum=[sum(inp[r][rq][j] for r in ranks) for j in range(D)]
            if random.random()<0.3: ssum=[x+1 for x in ssum]
            sl.append({"seq":rq,"ranks":list(ranks),"sum":ssum})
        states.append({"delivered":dl,"slots":sl})
    names=list(set([random.choice("abcdefg") for _ in range(random.randint(1,4))]))
    edges=[]
    seen=set()
    # choose a "spine" to make chains/cycles
    spine=[list(range(n))]
    for _ in range=random.randint(0,0):
        pass
    vals=[random.randrange(n) for _ in range(random.randint(4,14))]
    for k in range(len(vals)-1):
        s,t=vals[k],vals[k+1]
        add=[s,t] if random.random()<0.7 else [t,s]
        s,t=add
        lab=random.choice(names) if random.random()<0.6 else "zz"
        key=(s,lab,t)
        if key in seen: continue
        seen.add(key); edges.append([s,lab,t])
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,6)):
        s=random.randrange(n); t=random.randrange(n)
        lab=random.choice(names) if random.random()<0.5 else "zz"
        key=(s,lab,t)
        if key in seen: continue
        seen.add(key); edges.append([s,lab,t])
    fair=[{"action":a,"mode":random.choice(["weak","strong"])} for a in random.sample(names, random.randint(0,min(len(names),3)))]
    start=random.randrange(n)
    req={"op":"audit","inputs":inp,"start":start,"edges":edges,"states":states,"fairness":fair}
    out=g['handle'](json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
    ref_saf, ref_term, wit = analyse(P,R,D,inp,states,[tuple(e) for e in edges],[(f['action'],f['mode']) for f in fair],start)
    problems=[]
    if out["safe"]!=ref_saf: problems.append("SAFETY %s vs %s"%(out["safe"],ref_saf))
    if out["safety"] is not None:
        p=validate.val_audit(req,out)
        if p: problems.append("safety witness invalid: "+p)
    if out["terminates"]!=ref_term: problems.append("TERM %s vs %s"%(out["terminates"],ref_term))
    else:
        p=validate.val_audit(req,out)
        if p: problems.append("liveness invalid: "+p)
    q={"op":"export","inputs":inp,"start":start,"edges":edges,"states":states,"fairness":fair}
    eo=g['handle'](json.loads(json.dumps(q)))
    p=validate.val_export(q,eo)
    if p: problems.append("export invalid: "+p)
    if problems:
        bad+=1
        print(json.dumps(req)); print(json.dumps(out)); print("PROBLEMS:", problems)
        if bad>2: break
print("done bad=",bad)
